extracted.intended_audience: EPA communications staff, public affairs officers, and EPA employees who prepare publications, printed materials, web content, and other communications products
extracted.subtask_description: Appendix listing the internal orders, manuals, external style guides, and regulatory references that govern EPA communications, publishing, production, and review. Serves as a bibliography/source list for policies and guidance that should be followed when developing EPA communications and printed/web products.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP Stylebook (EPA intranet)
rubrics_metrics.description: An on-line version of the AP Stylebook (copyright 2003) is available to EPA employees with access to the EPA Intranet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Associated Press Stylebook as a primary editorial/style reference for writing (see AP Stylebook and its FAQs).

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Product Review Site
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains product development and review for all media, including print, Web, audio-visual, and displays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Product Review Site procedures for product development and review across media types.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Government Printing Office Style Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: The GPO's printer stylebook contains rules for preparing products to be printed by the GPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with GPO Style Manual requirements when preparing materials to be printed by the Government Publishing Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merriam-Webster's On-line Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes a dictionary, thesaurus, Spanish-English dictionary, word of the day and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Merriam‑Webster online resources for authoritative spelling, definitions, and usage guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain Language (U.S. government guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. government site providing guidance/instruction and training materials for writing in plain language across the federal government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt plain language practices in federal communications to improve clarity and accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title 44, United States Code — Public Printing and Documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains the broad legal framework for all Government publishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the legal framework in Title 44 when producing government publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint Committee on Printing — Government Printing and Binding Regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains the authority for Government printing and binding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow Joint Committee on Printing regulations for printing and binding performed under government authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: OMB Circular A-25 — Free distribution of Government documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes free distribution of Government documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow OMB A-25 rules regarding distribution and free dissemination of government documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 1000.25 — Use of Recycled Paper
rubrics_metrics.description: States: '...contractors use recycled paper for all reports required for delivery to the Agency.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require use of recycled paper for reports delivered to EPA; incorporate recycled-paper requirements into procurement/contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 1015.1B — EPA Identification Signs at Project Sites
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies to sites of projects which are operated or sponsored by EPA and applies to publicly visible construction site and demonstration project. It prohibits the appearance of 'names of Program Offices'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow signage rules for project sites; restrict appearance of program office names per the Order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 1015.2A — EPA Seal and Agency Identifier
rubrics_metrics.description: Governs 'visual communications' and emphasizes: '...all organizational units use...this order and those in the EPA Graphic Standards System Handbook...' It states specific uses for the Official Agency Seal and Agency Identifier and prohibits other visual identification forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Official Agency Seal on stationery, flags, buildings, and project identification signs; use of the Seal is optional on calling cards and official Agency reports. Use the Agency Identifier on all brochures and other printed matter. Do not use visual identification forms other than those in this Order. Prohibits use of EPA symbols for commercial purposes or for promotion/sale of private goods/services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 1440.7 — Hazard Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes minimum requirements for the hazard communication program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with the Order's minimum requirements when preparing hazard communications and related materials (specific program requirements are set in the Order).

rubrics_metrics.name: 00.4A — EPA Publication Review Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes policy and procedural requirements for the review of materials published or issued by the EPA and that the aforementioned have been developed using methodology which will achieve high quality results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow publication review procedures: decentralization empowers senior Office/Regional staff with responsibility for substance, form and policy implications and permits internal review procedures and a formal concurrence form; centralization requires forwarding any material that has policy implications to the Office of External Affairs (Office of Public Affairs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 2510.1 — Procurement of Employee Business Cards
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides guidance on using EPA appropriated funds to procure employee business cards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Order's instructions when procuring employee business cards using appropriated funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order 4800.1A1 — EPA Policy for Providing Wearing Apparel to Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides policy regarding provision of wearing apparel to employees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to policy provisions when acquiring or providing wearing apparel to EPA employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Information Policy — Children's Privacy and Children's Copyright (2182.0)
rubrics_metrics.description: Protects the privacy of children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure communications and posting practices comply with policies protecting children's privacy and copyrights.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Information Policy — Posting Copyrighted Works on EPA Web Site (2181.0)
rubrics_metrics.description: Established EPA policy regarding the appropriate use of copyrighted works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the policy when posting or using copyrighted works on EPA websites; obtain permissions as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Information Policy — Information Access Policy (2171.0)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes coordination of publications with GPO and how EPA must also submit government‑sponsored scientific, technical, engineering and related business information to the National Technical Information Service (NTIS) as required by federal law, regulation or policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate publications with the GPO and submit required materials to NTIS in accordance with law and agency policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Information Policy 2180 — Web Governance and Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes policy for EPA to operate and maintain a public access Web site to assist in fulfilling the Agency's mission. NSCEP maintains the web site for all of EPA's publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow web governance policies; use NSCEP processes for publishing EPA publications online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications Manual No. 1500
rubrics_metrics.description: An EPA communications manual (27 pp) listed among agency references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult and follow the Communications Manual for agency communications policies and procedures (internal reference).

rubrics_metrics.name: Printing Manual 4822
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the policies and procedures for the preparation, procurement and distribution of printed and other reproduced written materials by EPA employees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Printing Manual's procedures when preparing, procuring, and distributing printed materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracts Management Manual (procurement guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections referenced address use of the Government bankcard for printing and procurement of novelty items for distribution; some sections have been superseded by the EPA Acquisition Guide (EPAAG).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow procurement rules in the Contracts Management Manual or, where superseded, the EPA Acquisition Guide for purchasing printing, novelty items, and related goods/services.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPAAR 1552.208-70 — Printing by Contractors
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquisition regulation clauses regarding printing by contractors; includes definitions; prohibitions; affirmative requirements for double-sided copying and use of recycled paper; permitted contractor activities; violations; and flowdown provision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure contractor printing contracts include EPAAR clauses: require double-sided copying, recycled paper use, define permitted activities, and include flowdown/violation provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Printing Management Circulars (e.g., 02-03, 03-03)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circulars describe policy regarding coated paper stocks and the use of the Government bankcard for photocopying needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply circular-specific policies such as permitted paper stock and bankcard photocopying procedures when managing printing and copying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional Communications for EPA — Guidance for EPA Staff (May 2008)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets forth policy and guidance for the use of promotional products in EPA communications programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow this guidance when selecting and using promotional products for EPA communications; ensure compliance with agency policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Best Practices Guide for Conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes printing of conference materials and related guidance for conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Best Practices Guide when planning and printing conference materials to meet agency standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Memorandum (Jan 19, 2001) — Environmental Standards for EPA Paper and Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes EPA policy for environmental standards for EPA paper and publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow environmental standards for paper and publications as described in the memorandum (e.g., recycled content and other environmental specifications).
